headline: Regency Centers (NASDAQ:REG) Q2 Earnings Crush Estimates, Raises Full-Year Outlook
summary: Regency Centers (REG) Q2 EPS beat estimates by over 90%, revenue in line. Raised 2026 guidance on strong leasing and occupancy gains.

headline: Regency Centers Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
summary: JACKSONVILLE, Fla., July 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Regency Centers Corporation (“Regency Centers,” “Regency” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: REG) today reported financial and operating results for the period ended June 30, 2026, and provided updated 2026 earnings guidance. For the three months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders was $0.61 and $0.56, respectively, per diluted share. Second Quarter 2026 Highlights Reported Nareit Funds From Operations ("FFO")
